mapping.draft_py:
# M20 Barkhide Troll. "This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it." is the EtBState of
# Shatterskull Charger's and Goblin Boarders' sentences without their gates. The activated
# ability's cost is {1} and the new CostRemoveCounter on the source ("this creature": the
# MAPPER_GUIDE self selector); its effect is B3-grant-kw-self's grant ("{1}: This creature gains
# flying until end of turn." parses to it) with HEXPROOF.
this_creature = Selector(
    count=QConst(value=1),
    mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
    filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
)
grant_self = Selector(
    count=QConst(value=1),
    mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
    filter=FAnd(children=(
        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    )),
    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
)
enters_with = EtBState(initial_counters=((CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1, QConst(value=1)),))
hexproof = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(
        CostManaGeneric(amount=QConst(value=1)),
        CostRemoveCounter(counter_kind=CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1, target=this_creature),
    )),
    effect=A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
        'ability': KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.HEXPROOF),
        'duration': DurationEot(),
        'target': grant_self,
    }),
)
abilities = [enters_with, hexproof, *compiled]

clauses.clause: This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
{1}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature: This creature gains hexproof until end of turn.

mapping.notes: Ontology round R11 (DESIGN_ATOM_ONTOLOGY 15): the cost is {1} and CostRemoveCounter(+1/+1) on the source. The probe's board card has no counter, so G1 shows the ability unpayable (CR 118.3); the packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/M20/barkhide_troll_* play it. Unverified.
